```{r}
# install.packages("hoopR")
```

```{r}
library(hoopR)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
all_players <- load_nba_player_box(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_season()
  )

sga <- all_players |> filter(str_detect(athlete_display_name, "Shai Gilgeous-Alexander")) |>
  filter(team_name == "Thunder") |>
  filter(did_not_play == FALSE) |>
  filter(season_type == 2) %>%
  select(12:28) %>%
  select(-plus_minus)
```

```{r}
write_csv(sga, "sga_stats_2025.csv")
```
